_description: `bind` beside a component's own value attribute (attribute_definitions.json common.bind: 'an alternative spelling to each component's own value attribute, which takes precedence when both are set'; `primaryValue` lists, per section, the attribute `bind` stands for first, then the other spellings of that value; a SelectBox's list is by its selectItemType — a Date SelectBox's value is selectedDate). Each case is a node as written and the node every reader must act on: a lone `bind` becomes the first attribute; beside any of them `bind` is dropped. `warning` is the sentence the layout's author is told (null: none): the normalizer says the 'is ignored' ones where it folds; the validator says each of them on a layout the normalizer did not fold; none is said twice. The jui layout normalizer runs this table; a runtime that reads layouts the normalizer did not fold must answer the same.

cases.name: a lone bind is the Switch's isOn
a static isOn beside bind is the value; bind is dropped
cases.warning: 'bind: @{on}' is ignored: 'isOn: true' is the Switch's value

cases.name: another spelling of the Switch's value counts as set
cases.warning: 'bind: @{on}' is ignored: 'checked: @{a}' is the Switch's value

cases.name: a CheckBox's checked beside bind
cases.warning: 'bind: @{c}' is ignored: 'checked: false' is the CheckBox's value

cases.name: a CheckBox's value is its associated value, not its state: bind is still its isOn
a static Slider value beside bind
cases.warning: 'bind: @{level}' is ignored: 'value: 0.5' is the Slider's value

cases.name: a lone bind is the Segment's selectedIndex
a SelectBox's selectedIndex beside bind
cases.warning: 'bind: @{pick}' is ignored: 'selectedIndex: 1' is the SelectBox's value

cases.name: a lone bind is the SelectBox's selectedValue
a lone bind is the Progress's progress
bind is not a Collection's data source: it stays, and the validator says so
cases.warning: 'bind' is not a Collection's data source; use 'items' (e.g. "items": "@{rows}")

cases.name: bind on a section it names no value of stays
a lone bind is a TextField's text (text is declared two-way)
a TextView's text beside bind
cases.warning: 'bind: @{t}' is ignored: 'text: note' is the TextView's value

cases.name: a lone bind is a Radio's selectedValue
a lone bind is a Date SelectBox's selectedDate
a Date SelectBox's selectedDate beside bind
cases.warning: 'bind: @{day}' is ignored: 'selectedDate: 2026-01-01' is the SelectBox's value

cases.name: selectedValue is not a Date SelectBox's value: bind is still its selectedDate, and the validator names selectedValue
cases.warning: 'selectedValue' has no effect on a Date SelectBox — its value is selectedDate

_attributes_for_description: The one function every reader of common.bind.primaryValue answers the same (the generated JsonUIBindPrimaryValue.attributesFor on Kotlin, attributes(for:node:) on Swift; the jui normalizer's AliasTable.bind_value_attributes; the shared validator's bind_value_attributes): the attributes `bind` stands for on a node of `type`, the first being where a lone `bind` goes. The type is looked up as a key of the table, else as the section its `_alias_of` names; a type_synonyms.json synonym is the caller's to resolve first. A list entry is the answer. An object entry {by, whenAbsent, lists} answers lists[node[by]] when node[by] is a string lists names, else lists[whenAbsent] (absent, an unknown value, a binding). No entry: [] (bind is not folded).

attributes_for_cases.name: a SelectBox with no selectItemType is the whenAbsent kind
a Date SelectBox's value is selectedDate
a selectItemType the lists do not name is the whenAbsent kind (matched as written)
a bound selectItemType is the whenAbsent kind
a section that is an alias answers as the section it names
a section the table does not name: nothing, and bind is not folded
the type as written: a spelling in another case is not the section

_style_description: The fold is on the node a renderer draws: its style merged (the node's own attributes win over the style's) and its responsive branch resolved. `styles` are the style files the node names; `drawn` is the node every renderer acts on. The jui normalizer leaves a node that names a style (or carries responsive overrides) as it is written, for the renderer's fold — folding it before the merge let a layout `bind` override a style's own value.

style_cases.name: bind comes from a style: a lone bind, folded after the merge (a Date SelectBox: selectedDate)
the own value comes from a style: bind beside it is dropped, and the style's value is drawn
